currentUserGoal: Allow some Memory Grove skills to have multiple upgrade levels, beginning with a ten-rank grass-touching strength memory whose first ranks grant +10% and +30% manual healing.
workCompleted: Added generic maxRank and rankCostIncrease fields to permanent memory definitions.
Added persistent per-memory rank state while preserving the existing owned-memory list for unlock and prerequisite logic.
Made old version-1 boolean memory saves migrate each owned memory to rank one automatically.
Added rank-aware purchase results, dynamic costs, max-rank handling, completion checks, and next-run persistence.
Made Soft Touch a ten-rank memory with costs 12, 18, 24, 30, 36, 42, 48, 54, 60, and 66 GT.
Implemented the requested triangular healing curve: ranks 1-10 grant +10%, +30%, +60%, +100%, +150%, +210%, +280%, +360%, +450%, and +550% manual healing.
Kept downstream branch unlocks dependent on owning rank one rather than completing all ten ranks.
Updated desktop and compact Memory Grove cards with current rank, max rank, current effect, next effect, dynamic cost, and completion state.
Updated the agent-readable DOM controls with rank, maxRank, cost, affordability, and completion information.
Updated dormancy summaries and browser debug state to expose ranked memory progress.
Fixed compact-card text overlap by using a concise current/next/cost presentation on phones.
verificationRun: npm run check passed: ESLint, 79 Vitest tests across nine files, TypeScript, and the Vite production build.
Tests cover rank-one and rank-two effects, escalating costs, the ten-rank cap, next-run persistence, save serialization, legacy-save migration, and rank clamping.
Desktop browser smoke showed Soft Touch 1/10 with Next: Manual +30% and Cost: 18 GT from the existing legacy save.
A real browser purchase advanced Soft Touch to 2/10, spent 18 GT, exposed the next 24 GT cost, and persisted rank two into the next active run.
Phone browser smoke confirmed the compact Current, Rank, Next, and Cost blocks no longer overlap.

release.status: Local checkpoint only; not pushed, merged, or deployed.

currentGitStatus: Expected after checkpoint commit: clean codex/field-equipment-recast branch.
The prior Memory Web foundation is commit 7295529.
knownIssues: Only Soft Touch uses multiple ranks so far; all other memories remain one-time unlocks until their curves are deliberately designed.
The +550% rank-ten effect is intentionally the direct continuation of the requested +10%, +30% triangular curve and will need balance playtesting.
The local in-app browser playtest save is now Soft Touch 2/10 with 31 GT because the real purchase path was verified.
Equipment unlock counts still count distinct memories, not total ranks, by design.
nextRecommendedSteps: Playtest several runs at Soft Touch ranks one through four before committing to the late-rank +550% ceiling.
Choose the next ranked foundation memories, likely Deeper Roots and Fast Touch, and define their own non-identical curves.
Add visual pips or a radial rank ring around ranked nodes once several tree nodes support levels.
Decide whether later ranks require branch milestones in addition to GT costs.
doNotRevert: Keep old boolean saves migrating to rank one without changing the save-version gate.
Keep rank one sufficient for prerequisite and equipment unlock checks.
Keep ranked completion separate from ordinary ownership.
Keep dynamic rank information exposed through the DOM bridge for agent testing.
Keep compact phone copy purpose-built rather than squeezing the full desktop lore paragraph into the card.
